description: This file defines the Drawing class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing an image or drawing object within a worksheet. It includes methods for handling image paths, types, and related properties, supporting features like URL-based images and image type conversions.

classes.name: Drawing
classes.description: Represents an image or drawing object in a worksheet, with capabilities to set paths, handle URLs, and manage image formats.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename extracted from the image path.

methods.name: getIndexedFilename
methods.description: Returns a unique filename using an MD5 hash of the path.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Retrieves the file extension of the image.

methods.name: getMediaFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename to use when storing the image in a zip archive, based on image type.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the current path of the image.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the image path, verifying its existence, URL, or zip location, and processes accordingly.

methods.name: getIsURL
methods.description: Indicates whether the current image path is a URL.

methods.name: setIsURL
methods.description: Sets the URL flag (deprecated, property mainly set via setPath).

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code representing the current state of the object.

methods.name: getImageTypeForSave
methods.description: Returns the image type suitable for saving (converted to PNG/JPEG/BMP/GIF).

methods.name: getImageFileExtensionForSave
methods.description: Returns the image file extension suitable for saving, e.g., '.png'.

methods.name: getImageMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.
